_comment: Route aliases: map the pipeline's keyword-route vocabulary to the mock's files (302-redirected to canonical .html so page URLs and to_have_url assertions stay canonical). Without these, journey discovery and cart-seeding derive /view_cart, /products, /checkout etc. and hit 404s, so cart-dependent pages never get scraped with items. Self-maps (/cart.html -> cart.html) are intentionally omitted: the static server already serves those paths.
